name: app.tidetrade/tidetrade
title: TideTrade
description: One published crypto trend rule on 140 assets: states, flips, the record, the rule. Read-only, free.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Today's tide on every asset under the rule: crypto breadth and the Core 30 by state (tide in, slack water, tide out), the flips on the newest completed candle, the current Sunday Tide Report, and one row per asset with band, direction, close, the Tideline, distance from it in ATR and percent, candle date and last flip. Filter by band, tier or class; daily by default, weekly with timeframe W. Cached a minute; the rows change a few times a day after each candle completes.

timeframe.description: D for daily candles (default), W for weekly.

band.description: Only assets in this state: IN (tide in), SLACK (slack water) or OUT (tide out).

tier.description: core: the 30 most liquid crypto assets; extended: the other 110.

class.description: crypto by default; index and commodity are an alpha and not for decisions.

limit.description: At most this many asset rows.

tools.name: asset
tools.description: One asset by id, symbol or name (btc, BTC, Bitcoin): its state on the last completed daily and weekly candle, the room to its line, the record of every daily trip since its replay (trips, losing share, average win and loss, best, worst, the rule against holding) and its most recent flips, with the page URL.

id.description: Asset id, symbol or name, e.g. btc, ETH, Solana.

tools.name: report
tools.description: One Sunday Tide Report from the public archive (every ISO week since 2025-W01): how many of the 140 crypto assets were tide in, slack or out on the candles completed by that Sunday, the Core 30, the week's flips, the leaders, the assets in slack water and the ledger hash of the day. The latest report without a week.

week.description: ISO week, e.g. 2026-W43. Omit for the latest.

tools.name: rule
tools.description: The rule manifest behind every state and flip: Supertrend parameters, ATR method, candle definitions, data sources per asset class, the schedule, record types, the changelog and the manifest hash.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search assets, reports and pages. Returns ids for fetch: snapshot, snapshot:W, asset:<id>, report:<week>, rule, page:<path>.

query.description: Free text: a coin name or symbol, a week like 2026-W43, or a topic such as breadth, rule, trend trading.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one document by id from search: snapshot (today's market, daily), snapshot:W (weekly), asset:<id>, report:<week> or report:latest, rule, page:<path>.
